findings.evidence:
`JSON_ARRAYAGG/JSON_OBJECTAGG` partial results explicitly allow `nil` elements/values: `pkg/executor/aggfuncs/func_json_arrayagg.go:78`, `pkg/executor/aggfuncs/func_json_objectagg.go:99`. `getRealJSONValue` returns `value.Clone().GetValue()` (NULL -> `nil`): `pkg/executor/aggfuncs/func_json_objectagg.go:137`. TiDB JSON builder treats `nil` as JSON null: `pkg/types/json_binary.go:656`.
Spill serialization iterates these entries and calls `SerializeInterface` on each: `pkg/executor/aggfuncs/spill_serialize_helper.go:150`, `pkg/executor/aggfuncs/spill_serialize_helper.go:158`. `SerializeInterface` has no `case nil` and panics on default: `pkg/util/serialization/serialization_util.go:175`. Deserialization similarly cannot represent `nil`: `pkg/util/serialization/deserialization_util.go:210`.
findings.fix: Extend the spill interface encoding to support JSON null: add a dedicated type code (e.g. `NilType`) and handle it in both `SerializeInterface` and `DeserializeInterface` (encode only the type code; decode returns `nil`). Add unit coverage for `nil` entries in `pkg/executor/aggfuncs/spill_helper_test.go:836` and `pkg/executor/aggfuncs/spill_helper_test.go:886`.
findings.impact: When hash aggregation spill is used with `JSON_ARRAYAGG`/`JSON_OBJECTAGG` and the input contains SQL `NULL`, spill serialization can panic (or abort the query via recovery), causing query failure under memory pressure and breaking correct JSON-null semantics.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed up to `upstream/master` (`b75374faa619e24e380292fdbdf0f6fe5bf11943`): `SerializeInterface` still lacks `nil` support and JSON aggs still admit `nil`.
findings.verify: Add a regression unit test that serializes/deserializes `partialResult4JsonArrayagg{entries: []any{nil, int64(1)}}` and `partialResult4JsonObjectAgg{entries: map[string]any{"k": nil}}` without panic and with exact round-trip. For end-to-end validation, run a query using `JSON_ARRAYAGG` over a nullable column while forcing HashAgg spill (low mem quota / tmp storage on OOM) and ensure it returns JSON `null` elements instead of error/panic.
findings.what: Spill serialization for `JSON_ARRAYAGG`/`JSON_OBJECTAGG` cannot handle SQL NULL (represented as `nil`), because the `interface{}` serializer/deserializer has no `nil` encoding. This makes spill paths for these aggregates crash/fail when NULLs are present.

subject: *: support serialization and deserialization of aggregate function for spill (#46632)
summary: This commit adds spill-oriented (de)serialization for many aggregate partial results. A remaining High-severity correctness/runtime issue is that JSON aggregates can legitimately contain `nil` (SQL NULL -> JSON null), but the spill interface serializer panics on `nil`, so spilling JSON aggregates with NULLs can fail.
